title: Pickle jar with no ingredients list at all

blocks.text: Nutritional Information (per 100 g): Energy 210 kcal, Protein 2.0 g, Carbohydrate 12.0 g, Total Sugars 4.0 g, Total Fat 17.0 g, Sodium 1450 mg
Manufactured by: Mother's Kitchen Foods Pvt Ltd, 7 Market Yard Road, Nagpur 440001, Maharashtra, India
Store in a cool dry place, use a dry spoon

notes: No ingredients declaration appears anywhere on the label, front or back. Isolated single violation of RULE-IN-FOOD-002. This is a non-vegetarian marked product (mustard oil based pickle sometimes contains fish/shrimp paste in some regions; here marked non-veg to exercise the brown symbol path) but no allergen keywords are present so the allergen rule stays not applicable.
